title: Career run: Kid Howard, Moody's road band, George Williams, Pepper's
summary: Lists his jobs: Kid Howard, three years on the road with Moody's band, George Williams' big band, Pepper's and spot jobs.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: The Tips was great. The salaries wasn't them, but the Tips was great. Then after I went with Tips Howard then, I stayed with him for a long while. Then I left. I went on the road with Dan Moody's band out of Buccaloosa. We traveled all over Tennessee, Louisiana, Mississippi. I stayed with him about three years. I came back. I went back with Kit Howard. I worked with Kit Howard about two years. Then I went with George Williams. I stayed with George Williams a long time. Then after George went to work at the Peddorf, he turned the big band over to me, but I gave it up because it was too much of a headache. The flaws didn't show up and come late. So I let that go and I went to work at Pepper's. You saw him out there at Pepper's, 327 Boydman Street with Pickle out there. That's where I worked for a long time out there. Peppers? Peppers, yeah. Peppers, yeah. Peppers, yeah. Peppers, yeah. Peppers, yeah. 327 Boydman Street. I worked there a little while. Then after George went to work at the Peddorf, he turned the big band over to me, but I gave it up because it was too much of a headache. The flaws didn't show up and come late. So I let that go and I went to work at Pepper's. You saw him out there at Pepper's, 327 Boydman Street with Pickle out there. That's where I worked for a long time out there. Peppers? Peppers, yeah. 327 Boydman Street. And I was there a little while. Then after that, pulled up. Well, I did spot jobs. Ways in different little clubs out there. Wow. Then doing up the spot jobs after that. Then we were hitting a few chips with Al. We came back but I was spotting around and playing different groups. Until I met my good friend. I went with him. But I mean there's other jobs that I did too, but I can't remember all of them.
Yeah, I know. Because I can-
And you know I worked with Morgan a long time too, with the brass band and the horn jobs with him, France Jobs.
